sheet.gridHint: One column per hour of the clinic clock ({{timezone}}). An empty cell in a past hour means nothing was scheduled there.
sheet.emptyHint: The grid appears as soon as there is a first prescription.
sheet.closedHint: Suspended: only the record of what was done remains here.
sheet.prnGuardrail.min_interval_minutes: The last dose was {{elapsed_minutes}} min ago and the minimum interval is {{required_minutes}} min.
sheet.prnGuardrail.max_doses_24h: {{given}} doses have already been given in the last 24h; the maximum is {{max}}.
sheet.prnGuardrailHint: This is a warning, not a block: the decision is yours, and it is recorded under your name.
sheet.partialHint: Only part was given: vomiting, refusal midway, lost access.
sheet.retroactiveHint: It was done earlier and is being written down now.
sheet.howLongAgo: How long ago it was done
sheet.retroactiveResult: Will be recorded as done at {{time}}.
sheet.notDoneHint: It was not given, and the reason stays on the sheet.
sheet.adjustVersion: Creates a new version linked to this one. The previous one is closed and its history stays on the sheet.
sheet.suspendMenuHint: Ends the prescription and cancels the pending doses.
sheet.suspendHint: The doses still pending are cancelled. What was already done stays on the sheet, in the ended-prescription row.
shift.roundHint: One card per patient, worst first. Finish one before moving to the next.
wall.footer: The wall and the sheet read the same task queue.
sheet.behindBanner_one: {{count}} late dose is behind on the grid
sheet.behindBanner_other: {{count}} late doses are behind on the grid
sheet.behindBannerHint: The grid starts now. Tap to see what came before.

prescription.doseWarning.breed_sensitivi: Breed with known sensitivity to this drug.
prescription.doseWarning.capped: Capped by the registered maximum total dose.
prescription.doseWarning.no_weight: The patient has no recorded weight, and without it there is no calculation.
prescription.doseWarning.no_concentratio: The presentation has no registered concentration: we can reach mg, not the volume.

error.ai_provider_unknown: The configured AI provider name is not valid.

prescription.firstNowHint.medication: The patient needs the dose immediately, outside the standard hours.
prescription.firstNowHint.fluids: The infusion starts now, not at the next anchor hour.
prescription.firstNowHint.monitoring: Take a reading now, without waiting for the next hour.
prescription.firstNowHint.nutrition: Offer it now, outside the standard hours.
prescription.firstNowHint.care: Do it once now, on top of the scheduled hours.
prescription.firstNowHint.procedure: Do it once now, on top of the scheduled hours.
prescription.doseAdjustHint: adjust if needed, the maths follows
devices.title: Clinic devices
devices.subtitle: Shared tablets and computers that sign in without a personal account. Each one has its own access: revoking one does not knock out the others.
devices.emptyHint: With no enrolled device, whoever works the front desk has to sign in with a personal account at every handover.
devices.nameHint: This is the name someone will recognise in the list on the day they need to take it offline.
devices.codeHint: Type this code on the device, under the Station tab. It lasts 5 minutes and disappears once used.
devices.codeWarning: This code shows once. If you close without using it, generate another.
devices.state.pending: Waiting for the code to be typed on the device
devices.confirmRevoke: Revoke {{name}}? It stops signing in at once, and the other devices keep working.
devices.lockedBanner_one: 1 device locked by PIN errors. Someone may be unable to record anything right now.
devices.lockedBanner_other: {{count}} devices locked by PIN errors. Someone may be unable to record anything right now.
devices.lockedHint: {{attempts}} wrong PINs in a row. The lock does not lift on its own: not even the right PIN gets in until someone unlocks it here.
devices.footer: An enrolled device keeps its own access and comes back on its own when switched on. Whoever performs a task still identifies by PIN for each clinical act.
login.notThisDevice: This is no longer this device
error.device_locked: This device is locked after wrong PIN attempts. An administrator has to unlock it under Management, Devices.
error.pin_same_as_current: The new PIN is the same as the current one.
mypin.title: My PIN
mypin.hint: It is what identifies you on the clinic's shared devices. Six digits.
mypin.mismatch: The two new PINs do not match.
mypin.firstTime: You do not have a PIN yet. Set one so you can work on the shared devices.
sheet.readOnlyForRole: You are viewing the grid but cannot record doses: executing a task belongs to the vet and the technician. Sign in with your own account to confirm a dose.
login.platformHint: Access for sales and support. It signs in outside any clinic, and everything you do inside a clinic is recorded in its trail under your name.
error.clinic_suspended: This clinic's subscription is suspended. Contact PlantãoVet to reactivate.
error.email_taken: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
error.signup_rate_limited: Too many sign-ups from this computer. Try again shortly.
error.trial_expired: Your trial ended. You can still read everything and discharge patients; to prescribe again, talk to us.
error.slug_taken: A clinic with this identifier already exists.
subscription.trialEnding_one: Your trial ends tomorrow. Contact PlantãoVet to continue.
subscription.trialEnding_other: Your trial ends in {{count}} days. Contact PlantãoVet to continue.
subscription.pastDue: A payment is overdue. Access continues; settle it to keep the system on the next shift.
subscription.expired: Your trial ended. You can still see everything and discharge patients; to prescribe again, talk to us.
platform.clinicsHint: Who pays, who is trialling, who stopped using it. Sorted by who needs attention first.
platform.emptyHint: The first sale starts here: create the clinic and hand its administrator the access.
platform.search: Search by name, identifier or contact
platform.summary: {{members}} on the team · {{patients}} admitted right now
platform.contactTitle: Who picks up on their side
platform.subscriptionHint: Plan, bed limit and status. Suspending closes the door at the next sign-in; whoever is on shift finishes it.
platform.teamHint: The two most common support calls: password and PIN. Everything lands in the clinic's trail under your name.
platform.notesPlaceholder: Commercial agreements, who decides, what was already asked.
platform.form.name: Clinic name
platform.form.slugHint: What the clinic types on the station login. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
platform.form.bedsHint: Soft: never blocks an admission, only warns the administrator.
platform.form.trialNote: The clinic starts on a 30-day trial. The administrator's password is generated and shown once, on the next screen.
platform.createdHint: Hand this access to the clinic's administrator. They sign in under Personal access and can change the password and register the team.
platform.passwordOnce: This password shows once. If you close without noting it, generate another from the clinic's page.
platform.closingWarning: Suspending or cancelling closes the door at the next sign-in. Whoever is on shift finishes it normally.
platform.confirmResetPassword: Generate a temporary password for {{name}}? The current one stops working at once.
platform.confirmResetPin: Clear {{name}}'s PIN? They set a new one on their next sign-in.
platform.pinReset: {{name}}'s PIN cleared. They set a new one under Change my PIN.
platform.resetDoneHint: Read it over the phone or send it by message. They sign in and change it right after.
platform.plansHint: What the clinic subscribes to. A plan is born, takes clinics while active, retires (nobody new joins) and migrates (everyone moves to another). Founder is just a plan you retire one day with a click.
platform.noActivePlans: No active plan. Create one under Plans before registering a clinic.
platform.form.trialPlanNote_one: This is a trial plan: the clinic starts a 1-day trial. The administrator's password is generated and shown once, on the next screen.
platform.form.trialPlanNote_other: This is a trial plan: the clinic starts a {{count}}-day trial. The administrator's password is generated and shown once, on the next screen.
platform.plan.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. It does not change later: it is what every audit entry already written calls the plan.
platform.plan.name: Name
platform.plan.bedsHint: Empty = no limit. The limit is soft: it never blocks an admission.
platform.plan.priceHint: Zero is legitimate: trials and courtesies cost zero.
platform.plan.trialHint: Zero = paid plan. Above zero makes it a trial plan: whoever joins starts on trial, with the end date already set.
platform.plan.notesPlaceholder: Launch price for the first 10, valid until December.
platform.plan.retireHint: Retiring does not touch whoever is already on the plan: it only stops new clinics from joining.
platform.plan.confirmRetire: Retire {{name}}? Nobody new joins; the {{count}} clinics on it stay until you migrate them.
platform.plan.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? This is only possible because no clinic is on it.
platform.plan.migrateHint: All {{count}} clinics move to the chosen plan, with its bed limit. Each gets an entry in its own trail saying where it came from and where it went.
platform.plan.migrateRetireHint: The founder-plan case: the promotion is over, nobody new joins.
platform.plan.empty: No plans. Create the first one to be able to register clinics.
platform.plan.editHint: Changing the limit or price here does not touch clinics already on the plan: what each has was agreed at the time. Migrating is the act that reapplies.
error.plan_retired: This plan is retired and takes no new clinics.
error.plan_code_taken: A plan with this code already exists.
error.plan_in_use: This plan has clinics. Migrate them before deleting.
push.offHint: Overdue critical doses and events flagged for a vet reach this browser, even with the tab closed.
push.onHint: This browser receives shift alerts. Click to turn off.
push.blockedHint: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the site settings to receive alerts.
